description: This is a Kotlin source file defining a Fragment (TatweejFragment) for an Android app, which displays a list of words related to Islamic prayer and allows audio playback for each word.

classes.name: TatweejFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of words with associated audio and manages playback controls.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView with words and sets up click listeners for playing audio.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Handles the playback of the selected word's audio, updating UI components accordingly.

methods.name: stopPlayback
methods.description: Stops and releases the MediaPlayer to cease audio playback.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Ensures playback is stopped when the fragment goes into the paused state.
